# Global settings reference (`TBot/settings.json`)

Read by `Program.MainAsync` / `InstanceManager` / `TBot.WebUI` **before any instance starts**.
Path resolution: default `AppContext.BaseDirectory/settings.json`, override `--settings=<path>`;
log directory default `<cwd>/log`, override `--log=<path>`. `SettingsService.GlobalSettingsPath`
is also consumed by the WebUI controllers. Same `ConfigObject`/ casing / absent-key semantics as
[instance.md](instance.md).

The `Instances` array selects multi-instance mode; each `Settings` path is resolved relative to the
directory of this file and becomes one `TBotMain` instance with the given `Alias`.
